title: The Export Telegram data box's mode is three fields kept in step by hand
trigger: n/a
effect: The box is Options(draft) when account_export_dialog is Some, Progress when the session has an export and account_export_progress_hidden is false, Hidden when the flag is true; account_export_seen caches the last progress. Every close path (on_close, .close, Cancel, Done, Hide, the poll) writes a different subset of them.
fix: enum AccountExportBox { Closed, Options(AccountExportDraft), Progress { seen: Option<AccountProgress> }, Hidden }, with the export's existence read from the session.

title: Export box mode is chat_export_dialog + chat_export_progress_hidden + chat_export_seen + the session's export
trigger: n/a
effect: Options / Calendar / Progress / Hidden / Closed are derived from an Option draft (with picking: Option<DateField>), a bool and the session's export; on_close, Cancel, Done and Hide each set a different subset.
fix: enum ChatExportBox { Closed, Options(ChatExportDraft), Progress, Hidden } with picking inside Options.

title: Chat export box stage is spread over chat_export_dialog, chat_export_progress_hidden, chat_export_seen and the session's chat_export
trigger: Open options, start, hide, finish, Done, close with X
effect: Options / Progress / Hidden / Ended are inferred from three UI fields plus a session Option; close handlers set progress_hidden = true even when no export exists; draft.picking and draft.month change together by hand
fix: enum ExportBox { Closed, Options(ChatExportDraft), Progress{hidden}, } and picking: Option<(DateField, YearMonth)>.

title: Export progress visibility is a bool beside the export box Option and the session's export
trigger: Start a chat or account export, close its box (progress hidden), start another export.
effect: chat_export_progress_hidden/account_export_progress_hidden are set and cleared by hand in about eight places (export_box.rs, export_progress.rs, account_export_*), next to the draft Option and the export_seen Option.
fix: One ExportView enum per export: Closed, BoxOpen(draft), ProgressShown(seen), ProgressHidden.

title: Account box: open, confirm_delete and confirm_logout are one stage held as three bools
trigger: n/a
effect: Both inline confirms can be armed at once (press Log out, then Permanently delete); each closer resets a different subset (submit_logout skips the inputs, submit_delete_account resets only confirm_delete).
fix: Option<AccountBox { confirm: Confirm::{None, Delete, LogOut}, reason, password }> with one close that drops it.

title: Account box reads TTL, auto-delete and password-state fetches as loading/busy bools next to error options
trigger: n/a
effect: account_ttl_loading + account_ttl_days + account_error, account_mutating, default_auto_delete_busy + default_auto_delete_error, password_state_loading + password_state are each a loading flag beside a value/error pair; open_account_lifecycle clears the error fields by hand because a cached value skips the fetch that would.
fix: Fetch<i32> for the TTL and the auto-delete time, Fetch<PasswordState> for the password state, and one Mutation { Idle, Running, Failed(String) } for the setters.

title: Age verification prompt: age_verify_open and age_verify_started are stages of one flow
trigger: n/a
effect: The gate is NotAsked / Prompting / Started held as two bools written in updates_sync_ui.rs and account_notices.rs.
fix: enum AgeGate { Idle, Prompting, Started } on AccountBoxes.

title: Recent-actions poll is an Option<ChatId> 'running' flag beside a detached task, plus a hooked bool
trigger: n/a
effect: event_log_poll says a detached spawn_scoped loop is running for a chat; the task is not stored, so the flag and the task are kept in step by the task clearing it through the main window at its end. event_log_hooked is a set-once 'started' flag for the scroll handler.
fix: Store the poll as Option<(ChatId, Task<()>)> so dropping it stops the loop and its presence is the running state.

title: Recent actions page upkeep is four hand-kept fields: event_log_hooked, event_log_poll, event_log_keystroke, event_log_autoload
trigger: Open/close the recent-actions page, switch chats and account
effect: hooked is a 'started' bool, poll an Option<ChatId> started flag cleared by the task tail via main(), autoload a length marker; none is tied to the open page
fix: One EventLogPage { chat, poll: Polling|Idle, hooked, autoload } value owned by the Group Settings view and dropped with it.

title: Recent actions page keeps event_log_hooked, event_log_poll and event_log_keystroke as separate stage fields
trigger: n/a
effect: event_log_poll: Option<ChatId> is a 'poll running' flag cleared by the loop's tail through the main window; event_log_hooked is a one-shot bool; the search debounce token is a counter. They are correct today but kept in step by hand.
fix: An EventLogPage { chat_id, poll: Task, search_debounce: Option<Task> } value owned by the RecentActions view, dropped when the view changes.

title: UsernameDialog carries a community id in a ChatId field
trigger: Open Rename community.
effect: UsernameDialog.chat_id is ChatId(community_id) with the real id also inside TextPromptKind::CommunityName; the kinds of id share one field and one dialog slot for two unrelated prompts.
fix: Put the owner inside TextPromptKind (CustomTitle{chat,user} / CommunityName{community}) and drop chat_id.

title: Group confirm is one session-wide slot with chat_id plus an action
trigger: Open any confirm (delete chat, block, delete topic) from the main window then another from a chat window.
effect: GroupConfirmDialog{chat_id, action} uses ChatId(0) for actions with no chat (DeleteContact, BlockContact, ClearPaymentInfo) and a second opener overwrites the first.
fix: Make the action carry its own target (no ChatId(0) placeholder) and own the dialog per window.

title: debug_confirm Option<bool> mirrors an open DebugModeConfirm box
trigger: run_secret_code sets debug_confirm = Some(enabled()) then open_box(DebugModeConfirm); only the box's on_close clears it.
effect: If the box is closed by a path other than its on_close (account switch, close-all), the Some stays until the next code; harmless today because the next open overwrites it.
fix: Carry the 'currently on' snapshot in the dialog kind (DialogKind::DebugModeConfirm{on}) so the box and its payload are one value.

title: Story composer's post flow is three bools plus local_error kept in step by hand
trigger: n/a (check_sent -> post_sent, save_sent, local_error set and cleared in story_composer.rs and frame_upkeep.rs)
effect: check_sent, post_sent and save_sent are mutually exclusive stages of one send (checking eligibility, posting, saving an edit) with local_error beside them; each writer must clear the others. Listed as baseline debt in scripts/implicit-state-baseline.txt.
fix: enum ComposerSend { Idle, Checking { request }, Posting { request }, Saving { request }, Failed(String) } on the composer, matched to the answer's request id.

title: Custom theme list is Option<Vec> plus Option<Task> (a hand-rolled Fetch)
trigger: n/a (custom_themes in reads.rs, refresh_custom_themes)
effect: custom = None with custom_read = Some means loading, custom = Some means ready; the two are kept in step in reads.rs:192-200 and refresh_custom_themes. A failed folder read cannot be represented (it is an empty list).
fix: One enum CustomThemes { Unread, Reading(Task<()>), Read(Vec<CustomTheme>) }.

title: Omarchy probe held as omarchy_probed bool beside omarchy Option, plus omarchy_watched
trigger: n/a
effect: omarchy_probed=false is 'not looked yet', probed+None is 'not on Omarchy', probed+Some is 'found'; omarchy_watched is a separate started flag for the watcher task (which is detached, so it cannot be stopped).
fix: enum Omarchy { Unprobed, Absent, Found { state, watch: Option<Task<()>> } } so the watcher is owned and stops with it.

title: AudioEngine stage is spread over track/building/sim_clock Options plus failed, start_failed, stale bools, parked_secs and error
trigger: n/a
effect: state() derives the stage from priority order of the fields (failed beats building, so a retry build after a failure reads Failed until it lands instead of Loading); combos like failed+building or stale+building are representable
fix: One `Stage { Idle, Building{..}, Loaded{track, stale_at: Option<f64>}, Failed{at, error}, Simulated(PlaybackClock) }` enum with the error inside the failing variant.

title: Output device lifecycle held as device Option, opening bool, failed_at Option and watched bool
trigger: n/a
effect: Closed/Opening/Open/Failed are kept in step by hand in open, install, Reopened::drop and look; e.g. device Some with opening true is representable
fix: `DeviceStage { Closed, Opening, Open{device, watched}, Failed{at} }`.

title: The active track is spread over playing_voice, playing_audio, player.chat, player.meta, seek_slider, track_length and the seek bools
trigger: Any play, stop, pause, finish or switch of a track.
effect: Two Options (voice and audio) that must never both be Some, plus chat/meta that must be Some exactly when one is, plus slider, track_length, seek_scrubbing, seek_preview_secs, seek_hover kept in step by begin_track_playback, stop_*_playback, clear_playback_state and release_player_chat. A caller that stops only one kind (demos/media.rs) clears the other's slider and length while its sound plays.
fix: One Option<ActiveTrack { kind, chat, message, meta, length, seek: SeekState }> where SeekState is an enum Idle | Hover | Scrubbing { preview }; stop drops it whole.

title: playback.tick and players.builds_watched are bools standing for 'a task runs'
trigger: Start a track (tick), or start the first non-simulated player (builds_watched).
effect: tick is set true before spawning and reset by the task's tail; the task's way out is 'no active track' only, a dropped continuation leaves it true (harmless today because the whole PlaybackUi is replaced with the screen). builds_watched is set once and never cleared. tick_shown is an Option that is also reset by hand with it.
fix: Store the tick as Option<Task> (or enum TickState { Off, Running { shown } }) in PlaybackUi so dropping it ends the loop and clears the flag.

title: builds_watched bool as a 'task started' flag
trigger: watch_audio_builds uses mem::replace(&mut builds_watched, true) and never clears it; the spawn_app task ends only when the app is gone.
effect: No bug today; if the task ever ended early the engine builds would never land again.
fix: Hold the watcher as Option<Task> / enum BuildWatch { Off, On(Task) }.

title: recovery_mode and accepted_registration_terms are reset by poll_live when auth changes, not by the auth stage
trigger: Auth moves away from WaitPassword or WaitRegistration (any path).
effect: Two UI values are valid only in one authorization state; notifications/mod.rs:467-480 clears them by hand each poll. A path that changes auth without that poll code (a restart of the connection, a screen replacement) relies on OnScreen being rebuilt.
fix: Keep step-specific UI in an enum keyed by the authorization state, rebuilt when the state changes.

title: Terms prompt is terms_step plus terms_age_ok plus terms_age_error
trigger: Terms of service box: tick the age box, press Agree without it, press Decline, Back.
effect: Three fields describe one prompt: the step enum, a bool for the ticked age and a bool for the shown error. They are written from three click handlers in dialogs/account_notices.rs and reset nowhere except the checkbox handler.
fix: enum TermsStep { Terms { age_ok: bool, age_error: bool }, DeclineSorry, DeleteWarning } on a Option<TermsPrompt> that exists only while notices.terms is Some.

title: Edit bot: dialog.filled plus session edit.name/about/load_failed plus a 150 ms fill loop
trigger: Open Edit bot for an owned bot
effect: BotEditDialog::filled says the fields hold the server texts and is set by a polling task (fill_bot_edit) from BotEditState::{name,about,load_failed}; Save enablement combines filled with the session state, and status text is a priority chain of load_failed/local_error/server_error/saving/saved/!loaded
fix: Fetch<BotEditTexts> in the dialog (Loading, Ready, Failed) filled by the answer; one SaveStage enum

title: Stop-generating stage is can_stop/stopped/stop_failed plus a request lookup
trigger: Bot streams a reply; user presses Stop
effect: The stage Streaming/Stopping/Stopped/StopFailed is encoded by PendingBotMessage::{can_stop,stopped,stop_failed} (state/session.rs:13) and by has_purpose_for_chat(StopPendingMessage) in the view; finish_pending_bot_stop and the error arm flip them by hand
fix: enum StopStage { Streaming, Stopping(RequestId), Stopped, Failed } on PendingBotMessage

title: Similar bots fetch: UI inserts Loading next to the request, section shows the same button while loading
trigger: Press 'Similar bots' on a bot card
effect: SimilarBotsFetch::Loading is written by the UI after the driver queued the request and removed by the error arm of the reducer; the panel treats Loading like absent (same fetch button, no progress, 'Already loading' note on repeat), with the Loading entry and the pending request as two copies of one stage
fix: Fetch<Vec<i64>> set by the driver when it sends, with the view showing a spinner for Loading and Retry for Failed

title: ChatbotDraft holds a stage as loaded bool + committed Option + confirm_leave bool + warning Option
trigger: Open Chat Automation.
effect: loaded/confirm_leave are hand-kept stage flags; loaded is filled from session.connected_bot and the screen polls every 200 ms (business_bot_watch) to copy it. Not a bug today beyond the entry below.
fix: enum ChatbotStage { Loading, Failed(String), Editing{..}, ConfirmLeave{..} }; drop the polling by applying the answer in the reducer.

title: ChatbotDraft: bot stage is `loaded` bool + `committed` Option + `warning` + `confirm_leave` bool
trigger: Chatbots screen: the draft is made before the server's bot is known (loaded=false), then loaded=true, then a bot is committed (committed Some), a risky right sets warning, leaving with found-but-unadded bots sets confirm_leave. The stage is spread over four fields (loaded is already a baseline entry in scripts/implicit-state-baseline.txt) and reset by hand at chatbots.rs:107,214,406,448.
effect: No wrong state found in the files read; the 'loaded' flag has no failed arm in the struct (failed is derived from the session at chatbots.rs:147).
fix: enum BotStage { Loading, Failed(String), NoBot{username}, Connected{bot, rights, warning: Option<..>}, ConfirmLeave{..} } inside the Chatbots screen variant.

title: BusinessDialog: the open screen is `view` plus a set of Option drafts kept in step by hand
trigger: Navigation inside the box (business_go / business_back / route_business_start_page_sticker, which sets d.view directly): d.view must agree with which of greeting, away, hours, day_rows, location, picker, start_page, link_edit, chatbot is Some (View::Picker needs picker; View::Greeting with greeting None means 'Loading'; Hub clears seven drafts by hand; link_edit/confirm_delete reset in business_go; local_error and note are two Option<String> that can both be set).
effect: No wrong state found beyond P-002, but every new screen must edit business_go's reset list, business_draft_missing, business_fill_draft and business_leave in step.
fix: One enum Screen { Hub, Greeting(Fetch<GreetingDraft>), Away(..), Hours{draft, sub: HoursSub}, Location(..), StartPage{draft, sticker_pick: bool-free sub enum}, ChatLinks{edit}, Chatbots(..) } so a draft exists exactly while its screen does, and a child view is a variant of its parent's.

title: CallSounds loop stage is player, looping, hold and again_at kept in step by hand
trigger: n/a
effect: Idle, Playing, Gap(until) is inferred from player.is_none()/empty()/lost() plus again_at Option; play(), keep_looping() and set_enabled() each reset a different subset.
fix: enum Loop { Off, Playing{sound,player,hold}, Gap{sound,hold,until} }.

title: SoundMarks is bools plus an id standing for the call sound stage
trigger: n/a
effect: call_id, connected, ended and muted record which cues played for the current call, reset by hand when call.id changes; ended needs marks.call_id==summary.call_id, so a call that was never synced while active plays no end cue.
fix: A CallCues enum per call id (Ringing, Connected{muted}, Ended) transitioning on state changes.

title: Recent calls fetch stage is four separate fields read together
trigger: n/a
effect: calls_list and calls_history_more combine recent_calls_loading() (Option<RequestId>), recent_calls_error, recent_calls_clearing and recent_calls_offset.is_empty() to decide loading, failed, has-more and clearing; error is cleared in several places by hand.
fix: One enum: Idle, Loading{request}, Failed, Ready{offset}, and a separate Clearing{request}.

title: LivePipLink.window Option is an Opening/Open flag
trigger: n/a
effect: window None means the PiP is still opening (deferred), Some means open; the deferred open, check_live_pip, detach and close each match it by hand with a source comparison.
fix: enum LivePip { Opening{source,account,return_to}, Open{source,account,window,return_to} }.

title: slow_mode_tick_chat is an Option used as a 'task started' flag
trigger: Open a slow-mode chat X, open slow-mode chat Y, return to X within one second.
effect: The Option names one chat while the tasks are one per start; X to Y to X starts a second task for X while the first still loops (double notify each second). The flag is only cleared by the task itself.
fix: Keep the tick as a stored Task owned by the composer (dropped on chat change) instead of a name guard.

title: Appearance Apply stage is sent + needs_boosts + session busy + session error
trigger: Open the Appearance box, Apply, edit, Apply again.
effect: The visible stage (Applying, Applied, Failed, NeedsBoosts, Editing) is derived from dialog.sent, dialog.needs_boosts, requests.has_purpose_for_chat and the session-wide chats_state.appearance_error, kept in step by hand in edit_chat_appearance and apply_chat_appearance.
fix: One ApplyStage enum on the dialog; the error is stored in the variant, matched to the chat and request ids.

title: DropOnRow holds a file-drag / forward-drag / preview mode as eight fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Any drag over the chat list: hover, position, paths, drag, rest, frozen, unfreeze, forward, in_list and preview are set and cleared in different handlers (drag_left, end_forward_drag, drop_*, over=false branches).
effect: No bug today beyond the ones listed; every new handler must clear the right subset (clear() resets all, over=false resets only hover/rest).
fix: enum ListDrag { Idle, Files{hover,position,paths,drag,rest}, Forward{drag,in_list,hover}, Preview } with the freeze (frozen + unfreeze) as one Option<Freeze>.

title: Topic chooser load stage is DropTopic::load_failed plus two session sets
trigger: Drop files on a forum row: the stage is load_failed (bool, in the baseline) OR threads.forum_topics_failed.contains(chat) OR forum_topics.contains_key(chat) OR bot_topics.is_some(), combined in drop_topic_failed/drop_topic_loaded/drop_topic_choices.
effect: load_failed never clears when topics later arrive; a failure that is retried shows 'could not load' only while choices are empty. No stuck state found.
fix: Hold Fetch<()> for the topics in DropTopic (Loading/Ready/Failed) written from the same answer, instead of a bool beside session sets.

title: Sidebar tab is two bools, 'mutually exclusive' only by convention
trigger: open_chats_tab/open_contacts_tab/open_calls_tab, archive_row.rs:114, the demos and open_folder_tab each set a different subset of contacts_tab_open and calls_tab_open.
effect: Bug above; the pair can hold (true,true) from any future writer that forgets the other.
fix: enum SidebarTab { Chats, Contacts, Calls } in ChatListUi.

title: Pinned-row drag is pin_reorder + pin_reorder_archived + pin_press + preview_press + preview
trigger: Mouse down on a pinned row sets pin_press (chat_row), the first drag move builds pin_reorder and clears preview/preview_press, release keeps pin_reorder for the slide, render drops it when settled.
effect: pin_reorder_archived is only meaningful while pin_reorder is Some; pin_press survives clicks that never drag.
fix: enum RowPress { None, Pressed{chat,y}, Peek{..}, Reordering{archived, reorder} } owned by ChatListUi.
